items.title_en: Mumbai Central Turns Into Film Set For John Abraham’s Cop Drama: ‘Kash Iss Din Cab Ki Jagah Local Liya Hota
items.title_zh: 孟买市中心成为约翰·亚伯拉罕的警匪剧《Kash Iss Din Cab Ki Jagah》的电影拍摄地
items.summary_en: The video shared on Instagram opens with John Abraham, dressed in a police uniform for his character in the upcoming project.
items.summary_zh: Instagram 上分享的视频以约翰·亚伯拉罕 (John Abraham) 开头，他在即将推出的项目中扮演的角色穿着警察制服。
